name: orchard-door-draw-two-v1
description: THE PAIRED CONTROL FOR THE ONE PRINTED EXCEPTION IN THE DOOR SET (v31, 02/09/2026). v31 made all five doors PLAIN - place a card on a suit's Notice Board, take that suit's action exactly as the core action performs it - with one exception: the Orchard door is Draw 3, where plain would be Draw 2. This arm removes the exception and makes it plain. THE ARITHMETIC THE EXCEPTION IS DEFENDING. A visitor pays 1 card onto the board. The bonus slot's OTHER option is a free Draw 1 (rules.turn.bonusDraw), which costs nothing. So a Draw 2 door costs 1 and returns 2, netting +1 - exactly what the free option gives for nothing - which makes it STRICTLY WORSE than its own alternative, because the free option also leaves the card in your hand. Draw 3 nets +2, and that single card is the whole margin the Orchard board has. The prediction is therefore sharp and falsifiable: under this overlay the Orchard Notice Board should take close to ZERO visitor traffic, from rivals and from its own owner alike, while every other door is unchanged. READ IN THIS ORDER: (1) door mix by suit, where Orchard should collapse and the other four should rise slightly as the traffic redistributes; (2) the bonus mix, where the Draw-1 share should rise; (3) the Orchard seat's win rate, which is the second half of the story - the Orchard seat loses the freight its board used to collect, and freight is the only thing the owner is ever paid; (4) cards drawn per turn, which is the sanity check that the arm did what it says. IF ORCHARD'S TRAFFIC DOES NOT COLLAPSE, the self-cancellation law has stopped describing this game and the exception can be retired - which would be the more interesting result of the two, because it would mean visitors are choosing doors on something other than card arithmetic. THE DIAL IN THE OTHER DIRECTION IS rules.turn.bonusDraw, not this: raising the free draw to 2 kills the Orchard door at 3 by exactly the same argument, and kills the other four with it.
